methodology: Preliminary verse-by-verse semantic screening. Checked English primary-text translations of Psalm 1:2 and Proverbs 22:24-25 on USCCB. These are broad thematic analogies only; Hebrew critical edition and manuscript witnesses not collated. No specific parallel established is not a claim of exhaustive absence.

staged_candidates.relationship: loose motif: nocturnal devotion to divine instruction
staged_candidates.similarity: Both describe engagement with divine instruction at night.
staged_candidates.difference: Psalm 1 describes a blessed individual meditating on Torah day and night; Qur'an 3:113 depicts an upright subset of the People of the Book reciting God's signs at night and prostrating.
staged_candidates.verification: English primary translation read; Hebrew textual witnesses and dating not collated.

staged_candidates.relationship: loose motif: caution in close associations
staged_candidates.similarity: Both warn against potentially harmful close association.
staged_candidates.difference: Proverbs warns against friendship with angry people lest one imitate their ways; Qur'an 3:118 warns believers against choosing confidants who wish them harm, in a communal polemical setting. These are not matching narratives or equivalent social categories.
staged_candidates.verification: English primary translation read; Hebrew textual witnesses and dating not collated.
